import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { db } from '@/lib/firebase-admin';

const DISCO_H = 'H:/EAR_OS_GOLD';

export async function GET() {
  try {
    let synced = 0;
    if (fs.existsSync(DISCO_H)) {
      const files = fs.readdirSync(DISCO_H).filter(f => f.endsWith('.md') || f.endsWith('.txt'));
      
      for (const file of files.slice(0, 5)) { // Procesamos en rÃ¡fagas de 5
        const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(DISCO_H, file), 'utf8').substring(0, 2000);
        await db.collection('neural_memories').add({
          type: 'FORENSIC_RECOVERY',
          fileName: file,
          content: content,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        });
        synced++;
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ status: 'success', syncedAtoms: synced });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: 'error', message: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

### 4. El Endpoint de FusiÃ³n (src/app/api/intel/matcher/route.ts)
Este endpoint une todo lo anterior.

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { db } from '@/lib/firebase-admin';
import { runUniversalMatcher } from '@/lib/intelligence/MatchingEngine';
import { sendSClassAlert } from '@/lib/services/TelegramService';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
    try {
        const { leadId, category } = await req.json();
        
        // 1. Obtener Lead y Proveedores
        const leadDoc = await db.collection('ear_leads').doc(leadId).get();
        const vendorsSnapshot = await db.collection('ear_vendors').get();
        
        const leadData = leadDoc.data();
        const matches: any[] = [];

        // 2. Ejecutar Matrix de Matching
        for (const vDoc of vendorsSnapshot.docs) {
            const result = await runUniversalMatcher(vDoc.data(), leadData, category);
            if (result.match) {
                matches.push({ vendorId: vDoc.id, ...result });
            }
        }

        // 3. Notificar vÃ­a Sistema Nervioso
        if (matches.length > 0) {
            await sendSClassAlert(`<b>MATCH DETECTADO!</b>\nLead: ${leadData?.name}\nMatches: ${matches.length}\nSistema: S-Class Matcher`);
        }

        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'success', matchesCount: matches.length, matches });
    } catch (err: any) {
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'error', message: err.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}
```

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

    let synced = 0;
    if (fs.existsSync(DISCO_H)) {
      const files = fs.readdirSync(DISCO_H).filter(f => f.endsWith('.md') || f.endsWith('.txt'));

        const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(DISCO_H, file), 'utf8').substring(0, 2000);

          type: 'FORENSIC_RECOVERY',
          fileName: file,
          content: content,
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        });
        synced++;
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ status: 'success', syncedAtoms: synced });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ status: 'error', message: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

### 4. El Endpoint de FusiÃ³n (src/app/api/intel/matcher/route.ts)
Este endpoint une todo lo anterior.

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { db } from '@/lib/firebase-admin';
import { runUniversalMatcher } from '@/lib/intelligence/MatchingEngine';
import { sendSClassAlert } from '@/lib/services/TelegramService';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
    try {
        const { leadId, category } = await req.json();
        
        // 1. Obtener Lead y Proveedores
        const leadDoc = await db.collection('ear_leads').doc(leadId).get();
        const vendorsSnapshot = await db.collection('ear_vendors').get();
        
        const leadData = leadDoc.data();
        const matches: any[] = [];

        // 2. Ejecutar Matrix de Matching
        for (const vDoc of vendorsSnapshot.docs) {
            const result = await runUniversalMatcher(vDoc.data(), leadData, category);
            if (result.match) {
                matches.push({ vendorId: vDoc.id, ...result });
            }
        }

        // 3. Notificar vÃ­a Sistema Nervioso
        if (matches.length > 0) {
            await sendSClassAlert(`<b>MATCH DETECTADO!</b>\nLead: ${leadData?.name}\nMatches: ${matches.length}\nSistema: S-Class Matcher`);
        }

        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'success', matchesCount: matches.length, matches });
    } catch (err: any) {
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'error', message: err.message }, { status: 500 });
    }
}
```

### ðŸ›¡ï¸ Ãšltima InyecciÃ³n de Poder (SQL)

Para activar el cerebro, ejecute este bloque en su **SQL Editor** de Supabase. Esto crearÃ¡ el motor de similitud por coseno:

```sql
-- ðŸ§  ACTIVACIÃ“N DE SINAPSIS VECTORIAL (RAG)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION match_vendors (
  query_embedding vector(768),
  match_threshold float,
  match_count int
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  name text,
  category text,
  location text,
  similarity float
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    v.id,
    v.name,
    v.category,
    v.location,
    1 - (v.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM ear_market_vendors v
  WHERE 1 - (v.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
  ORDER BY v.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$$;
```

```sql
-- ðŸ§  ACTIVACIÃ“N DE SINAPSIS VECTORIAL (RAG)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION match_vendors (
  query_embedding vector(768),
  match_threshold float,
  match_count int
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  name text,
  category text,
  location text,
  similarity float
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    v.id,
    v.name,
    v.category,
    v.location,
    1 - (v.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM ear_market_vendors v
  WHERE 1 - (v.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
  ORDER BY v.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$$;
```

### ðŸ›¡ï¸ Ãšltima InyecciÃ³n de Poder (SQL)

Para activar el cerebro, ejecute este bloque en su **SQL Editor** de Supabase. Esto crearÃ¡ el motor de similitud por coseno:

```sql
-- ðŸ§  ACTIVACIÃ“N DE SINAPSIS VECTORIAL (RAG)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION match_vendors (
  query_embedding vector(768),
  match_threshold float,
  match_count int
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  name text,
  category text,
  location text,
  similarity float
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    v.id,
    v.name,
    v.category,
    v.location,
    1 - (v.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM ear_market_vendors v
  WHERE 1 - (v.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
  ORDER BY v.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$$;
```

### ðŸ›¡ï¸ Ãšltima InyecciÃ³n de Poder (SQL)

Para activar el cerebro, ejecute este bloque en su **SQL Editor** de Supabase. Esto crearÃ¡ el motor de similitud por coseno:

```sql
-- ðŸ§  ACTIVACIÃ“N DE SINAPSIS VECTORIAL (RAG)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION match_vendors (
  query_embedding vector(768),
  match_threshold float,
  match_count int
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  name text,
  category text,
  location text,
  similarity float
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    v.id,
    v.name,
    v.category,
    v.location,
    1 - (v.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM ear_market_vendors v
  WHERE 1 - (v.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
  ORDER BY v.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$$;
```

### ðŸ›¡ï¸ Ãšltima InyecciÃ³n de Poder (SQL)

Para activar el cerebro, ejecute este bloque en su **SQL Editor** de Supabase. Esto crearÃ¡ el motor de similitud por coseno:

```sql
-- ðŸ§  ACTIVACIÃ“N DE SINAPSIS VECTORIAL (RAG)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION match_vendors (
  query_embedding vector(768),
  match_threshold float,
  match_count int
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  id uuid,
  name text,
  category text,
  location text,
  similarity float
)
LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    v.id,
    v.name,
    v.category,
    v.location,
    1 - (v.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM ear_market_vendors v
  WHERE 1 - (v.embedding <=> query_embedding) > match_threshold
  ORDER BY v.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
END;
$$;
```
